verdict.rationale: The evidence shows one maintained first-party commerce integration: the free Mailchimp for Magento connector, which syncs customers and order data into audiences and enables e-commerce ROI tracking. Nothing in the pack covers Stripe, Shopify, a CDP like Segment, or a native product-database connector. The Marketing API and webhooks that sync profile data with your own database are developer building blocks, so they earn no credit here. missing for 10: Stripe integration, Shopify integration, Segment/CDP integration, a native product-database connector, an integration catalog or maintenance evidence, independent corroboration
